notes: PHASE-000 foundation is complete and PHASE-001 development is active. WU-002 remains in progress. The verified Windows audio implementation includes Rust audio contracts and bounded queues, device catalog/reselection, bounded stream recovery, IAudioClient3 shared-mode period planning, SharedCapturePlan cadence, event-driven WASAPI IAudioCaptureClient capture, native sample decoding, packet reframing and AudioFrame assembly, a bounded event-driven CapturePump, structured recoverable WASAPI lifecycle failures, CaptureRuntime with externally scheduled bounded reopen recovery and sequence continuity, IMMNotificationClient registration on a dedicated Windows MTA thread with bounded non-blocking notification delivery, and owner-thread capture-route notification filtering/deduplication. A bounded user-mode virtual-microphone staging/output boundary is now also verified: VirtualMicStagingBuffer enforces a fixed format, drops the oldest frame on overflow to bound latency, emits fresh silence on underrun rather than replaying stale speech, and exposes accepted/drop/underrun counters. VirtualMicOutputBridge sends both successfully processed AudioPipeline frames and original safe-bypass frames after optional processing failures through that same staging path. The staging-only boundary passed Ubuntu run 34522446261 and Windows run 34522445865; the exact output-bridge implementation head 6d5d0b9ac29db97d0c475dbdde6827187989c38f passed Ubuntu repository-integrity run 34522943083 and Windows Audio Validation run 34522943093. This is not evidence of an OS-visible virtual microphone. Physical unplug/replug or communications-default change firing and successful recovery on controlled hardware, hardware CPU/latency/jitter/deadline evidence, the OS-visible virtual microphone endpoint/driver, actual kernel/user-mode driver transport, processed/bypass audio reaching approved calling applications, and driver signing/install/update/uninstall/rollback remain pending. README and docs/architecture/WINDOWS-AUDIO-IMPLEMENTATION.md are reconciled to this boundary. WU-002 and MOD-002 are not complete until required routing, compatibility and performance evidence exists. Paid provider usage, proprietary model training, production credentials/cloud spend and production deployment remain subject to applicable provider/data/compute/release gates.
